home.title: Fody Labs — Products & Platforms
home.heroDesc: Creators of Rent.wf, the Taxi & P2P Marketplace Engine and FodyChat. We build turnkey software, launch P2P marketplaces and automate support — without monthly markups. Cross-platform apps for every device from a single codebase.
home.productsDesc: Each one solves a concrete business problem — and is already working for real customers.
home.rentFor: Instant booking sites for villas, hotels, car rentals and yachts.
home.rentValue: No aggregator commissions (Booking/Airbnb), a built-in AI assistant, Telegram alerts for your team — and pages that load even on weak Wi-Fi.
home.taxiFor: A ready core for launching local taxi and guide services — like taxi.rent.wf.
home.taxiValue: Counter-offers (drivers set their own price), AI chat with tourists in their language, and no middlemen.
home.chatFor: A smart AI support widget for any website.
home.chatValue: ~3 KB loads instantly, answers strictly from your data (FAQ/API), and hands off to a human on Telegram. Perpetual self-host (BYOK) available.
home.radFor: Our flagship cross-platform case — internet radio with 50,000+ stations, ad-free.
home.radValue: One codebase → iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and the web. Live in four app stores and as a PWA.
home.techDesc: We translate the stack into business results — not buzzwords.
home.techSpeedDesc: Jamstack on Cloudflare — no heavy servers, no crashes under load, opens instantly anywhere in the world.
home.techAiDesc: The bot answers only from your documents and prices — no hallucinations, no data leaks.
home.techMobileDesc: One app that runs natively on phones, tablets and desktops — up to 50% less budget. Proven by Radioller.
home.trustDesc: Our products run this smoothly because a quarter-century of systems engineering stands behind them. We don't assemble sites on builders — we write fault-tolerant architecture.
home.ctaDesc: Let's discuss your project. We'll help you choose the right platform and technology stack.

about.title: About — Fody Labs
about.description: Learn about Fody Labs — 25+ years building desktop, web, and mobile software.
about.label: About Us
about.intro: Since the late 1990s we’ve been shipping production software — from COM/ActiveX components to modern cross-platform mobile apps.
about.storyP1: Fody Labs started as a one-person consultancy and grew into a focused engineering studio. Over 25+ years we’ve worked with startups, enterprises, and everything in between — always hands-on, always code-first.
about.storyP2: Today we specialize in .NET MAUI and Flutter mobile development, building apps that feel native on every platform while sharing a single codebase. We combine deep platform knowledge with modern AI tooling to ship faster without cutting corners.
about.value1Desc: We write code, review code, and ship code. No committees, no slide decks.
about.value2Desc: Small team, fast decisions. You talk directly to the engineer building your product.
about.value3Desc: Working software over documentation. We iterate in short cycles with real builds.
about.value4Desc: We use AI tools daily to accelerate development — not replace engineering judgment.
about.timeline1999: Started building desktop applications with Delphi and C++
about.timeline2005: Transitioned to .NET ecosystem — WinForms, WPF, ASP.NET
about.timeline2022: Adopted .NET MAUI for cross-platform mobile development
about.timeline2024: Integrated AI tooling into daily engineering workflow
about.timeline2026: Added Flutter to the cross-platform mobile toolkit
about.fodyText: The fody is a small, vibrant bird native to the islands of the Indian Ocean. It looks like a beautiful red sparrow — the kind every ordinary sparrow would probably want to be, if only it could. Bright, resourceful, and perfectly adapted to island life — the fody felt like a natural fit for a studio that builds smart, lightweight software from a tropical base, serving clients around the world.

work.title: Our Work — Fody Labs
work.description: See Radioller — a production cross-platform app we built to demonstrate what we deliver.
work.label: Our Work
work.intro: Most projects we ship are under NDA. Radioller is our open proof-of-work — a full-featured internet radio app, live on four app stores.
work.appDesc: A production internet radio app, live on four app stores and as a PWA on the web. Built in C# from end to end — .NET MAUI on mobile and desktop, Blazor on the web.
work.f1Desc: Mobile and desktop apps run on .NET MAUI — native performance on Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows from a single codebase. The web version is a PWA, sharing the same C# business logic across all five platforms.
work.f2Desc: Compact layout on phones, split-panel on tablets, resizable panes on desktop. Smooth reflow between portrait and landscape without losing playback.
work.f3Desc: Switch interface language inside the app with immediate effect. English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, and Ukrainian — all built in.
work.f4Desc: Lock screen controls, AirPods, car stereos, Bluetooth headsets — every media button handled. Audio focus and ducking follow platform conventions exactly.
work.f5Desc: Full dark and light mode with automatic system detection, switchable at runtime without restarting. Every colour, icon, and background updates instantly in one pass.
work.f6Desc: The full catalogue is bundled locally — search and browse without internet. Filter by country, genre, or language. Only the stream needs a connection.
work.ctaDesc: Have something in mind? We’d love to hear from you.
work.rentwfDesc: A direct-booking platform for rental owners — villas, cars, charters — with an always-on AI assistant: commission-free, multilingual, self-hosted on your own domain. Its sister project, Rent Taxi, is a ride-and-tour app where licensed driver-guides bid their own fares.
work.rentwfF1Desc: Answers every guest in their language, 24/7, using only real availability and house rules — then hands hot leads to your team.
work.rentwfF2Desc: Eight languages, real-time availability, and pages that load even on weak Wi-Fi. Hosting included.
work.rentwfF3Desc: Licensed driver-guides bid their own fares and turn airport transfers into island tours — no aggregator taking a cut.
work.chatTagline: An embeddable AI support chat that answers from your data.
work.chatDesc: A multi-tenant AI chat widget for any website — paste an FAQ, index documents (RAG), or connect your own search API (tools). The AI answers in the visitor's language, hands off to a human operator on Telegram, Slack, or email, and can self-host on your own Cloudflare with your own keys.
